title: AI for AI: Optimizing Additional Infrastructure Build-out to Power Artificial Intelligence Data Centers
abstract: arXiv:2609.08166v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The twenty-first century's transformative technology, artificial intelligence, is increasingly constrained by the twentieth century's transformative technology, the electricity grid. Rapid growth in electricity demand from data centers is leading to higher electricity prices, without a compensating supply-side response. We develop a framework linking data-center load growth, available generation capacity, and market-clearing prices to understand this phenomenon. We first analyze a deterministic model to show how differing estimates of demand and supply growth rates affect prices. We then model the expansion of new data centers and their associated electricity demand, together with build-outs of new electricity supply, as stochastic processes,resulting in probabilistic distributions of supply, demand, and prices rather than a single forecast. translated_title: 人工智能助力人工智能：优化额外基础设施建设以驱动人工智能数据中心
translated_abstract: 二十一世纪的变革性技术——人工智能，正日益受到二十世纪的变革性技术——电网的制约。数据中心电力需求的快速增长正在推高电价，而供给侧却没有相应的响应。我们开发了一个将数据中心负荷增长、可用发电容量和市场出清价格联系起来的框架，以理解这一现象。我们首先分析了一个确定性模型，展示对需求和供应增长率的不同估计如何影响价格。随后，我们将新数据中心的扩张及其相关电力需求，连同新电力供应的建设，建模为随机过程，从而得到供应、需求和价格的概率分布，而非单一预测。最后，我们将发电容量扩张表述为一个随机控制问题，其中收益最大化的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了一个将数据中心负荷增长、发电容量与市场出清价格相联系的框架，并将电力基础设施建设建模为随机控制问题，以优化支撑人工智能数据中心的电力供应扩张决策。
en_tdlr: The paper develops a framework linking data-center load growth, generation capacity, and market-clearing prices, and formulates electricity infrastructure build-out as a stochastic control problem to optimize power supply expansion for AI data centers.
